hydrozing.translation: (防止表面氧化的)氢气(圈内)热处理, 氢气保护热处理

hydrozoa.definition:
n coelenterates typically having alternation of generations; hydroid phase is usually colonial giving rise to the medusoid phase by budding: hydras and jellyfishes
n colonial coelenterates having the polyp phase dominant

hydrozoal.definition: a. Of or pertaining to the Hydrozoa.

hydrozoan.definition: n. colonial coelenterates having the polyp phase dominant
hydrozoan.translation:
a. 水螅虫的
n. 水螅虫
